newsitem.title: USA: Duff & phelps may upgrade Santa Fe Pacific.
newsitem.headline: Duff & phelps may upgrade Santa Fe Pacific.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesday it placed the senior debentures of Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp on rating watch for a possible upgrade.
The current rating of the debentures is Triple B Minus. About $200 million of senior debentures are affected.
It said the action follows an announcement of a tentative agreement between Homestake Mining Co and Santa Fe Pacific Gold for the two companies to merge in a tax-free exchange of shares.
Homestake expects to pay about $17.40 per share, or $2.3 billion, for Santa Fe Pacific Gold shares, Duff & Phelps said.
